description: Updates product fields – texts, status, handle, images, collection, categories, tags, sales channels, metadata. Send only the fields that should change. Lists (category_ids, tags, images, sales_channel_ids) replace the previous list.

collection_id.description: null removes the product from its collection

metadata.description: Merged into existing metadata; an empty string deletes a key

tags.description: Tag values; missing tags are created

name: update_product
title: Update product
